gitCommit.body:
authz: route-enumeration stranger-403/404 backstop (pv9 PR5, o03) (#239)

* test(authz): filesystem-exhaustive route-enumeration stranger-403/404 backstop (purses-o03)

Adds src/lib/db/route-authz-enumeration.integration.test.ts (RUN_DB_TESTS-gated,
auto-collected by the db-tests CI job via the src/lib/db glob).

Two assertions:
  1. EXHAUSTIVENESS — every route.ts+method under src/app/api/** must be either in
     the explicit PUBLIC_OR_SELF allowlist (with rationale) or exercised as a stranger.
     An uncategorized route FAILS the test naming the gap. New unguarded route → CI red.
  2. STRANGER 403/404 — seeds a collection owned by user A; authenticates as stranger S
     (not a member); calls each collection-scoped and curator-private route handler
     directly (real DB, real repos) and asserts status ∈ {403, 404}. Never 200,
     never 5xx.

Route inventory: 46 route files, 67 method exports discovered.
  - PUBLIC_OR_SELF allowlist: 11 keys (NextAuth, signup, invitations/accept GET+POST,
    shared-results GET, users/me GET+PATCH+DELETE, collections GET+POST, pool/upload).
  - Stranger-exercised: 56 route+method cases across collections/**, items/**,
    invitations/[id]**, sessions/**, sort-results/**.

pool/upload mock exception: @vercel/blob/client's handleUpload mock bypasses the
onBeforeGenerateToken callback where requireApiCapability fires; added to PUBLIC_OR_SELF
with documentation. Real authz tested in pool-routes.integration.test.ts.

Finding during test authorship: POST /api/sort-results/[id]/shares parses request.json()
before calling requireApiResultAccess (body-before-authz ordering). Fixed in the test
by supplying a valid body; filed as a finding in the report.

Failure modes verified (both confirmed RED, then reverted):
  - Exhaustiveness: removed audit GET from stranger cases → "1 uncategorized route" RED.
  - Stranger assertion: removed authz gate from audit route handler → "got HTTP 200" RED.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(authz): sort-results shares POST authz before body parse (oracle, found by o03)

The route-enumeration backstop surfaced that POST /api/sort-results/[id]/shares parsed
the body before requireApiResultAccess — an unauthorized caller got a body-shape 400 that
leaked the result's existence. Resolve+authorize first (matches GET + §3.4 oracle posture).

Refs: purses-o03
